messages.text: Landed. West ladder: Threshers, Hyphy, Rainmakers, Tsunami, Lumberjacks.
First plane, youngins. Nothing broke down. Not even me.
Pops held the armrest for 5 hours. both armrests. one was mine
WE'RE AT THE BEACH 🌊🌴 A PELICAN LOOKED AT ME. HE KNOWS WHO WE ARE
he does not
Win this region and my next text is one word. Don't make me wait.
LA first. let's work
{crew}. Lou. Four regions from nowhere. Never been done. I checked.
The West has your tape on loop. They don't scare easy. Teach 'em.
lessons start saturday
Mayor of the boulevard here. Saw y'all on my feed. Four regions. Cute.
Out here we roll low and slow. Then the JAWS DROP. Then you sink.
Saturday, 4pm. Golden hour. Look good losing, {crew}.
we look good either way
Threshers hit .350 at sunset. sun's right in the fielders' eyes. on purpose
GOT SUNGLASSES 😎 boardwalk special. one lens is darker than the other
Six miles. Ninety minutes of traffic. We leave at noon. That's LA.
Smooth crews hate a rush, youngin. Speed the game up on 'em.
WE BEAT LA 🌴🔥 THE JAWS DIDN'T DROP. THEY CLOSED
Doc Hydraulics' pitch bounces twice before the plate. we waited. it worked
Lowrider Lou asked for a picture with Pops. Pops struck a pose.
Had a pose in '98 too. Nobody saw it. Bus.
THE BUS AGAIN 😭
Oakland next
Jaws dropped. Y'all sank. Enjoy the beach on your way out, {crew}.
first game out West, first L. statistically normal. emotionally no
run it back
Mayor runs the Threshers like a parade. Every play gotta look pretty.
Sometimes I just wanna win ugly. Y'all win any way you can.
we win ugly a lot
I noticed. That's a compliment.
Room on {crew} for me?
{crew}!! It's the TOWN, baby! We go dumb out here. Ask Dante. He's the expert.
GHOST RIDE: runner takes off, nobody's driving, the bases just move.
Saturday by the lake. Bring dancing shoes. The game IS the party.
we'll dance after we win
THE TOWN!!! been practicing my turf dance in the hotel 🕺🕺
the front desk called. twice
Hyphy score in bunches. 6 runs in one inning is a normal Tuesday for them
Train to the lake, then a bus. Pops. Don't.
I wasn't gonna say nothing, youngin.
...it was a long bus though.
WE WENT DUMBER THAN THE TOWN 😂🕺 AND WON
not the flex you think it is
Sideshow Sly ghost-rode 3 times. tagged him twice. the third he's still running
Turf Dancer Tre taught Dre the dance after. Dre still can't do it.
I DID IT IN MY HEART
The Town gave you respect, youngins. Don't spend it all in one place.
Seattle. bring a jacket
GHOST RIDE!! Y'all couldn't catch nothing! Go home, {crew}! Love y'all tho!
they're so NICE about beating us. it's worse
run it back
AYY. real talk, I love the Town. The Town loves me.
But y'all play like you got somewhere to be. I wanna go where y'all going.
we're going to Baltimore
Then I'm going to Baltimore! Got room on {crew}?
Hello, {crew}. It's raining. It's always raining. We prefer it.
Wet ball skids. Wet bases slide. When the DOWNPOUR hits, you lose your feet.
Don't bring umbrellas. We laugh at umbrellas. Quietly. But we do.
we'll bring towels
31 days of rain straight. Rainmakers went 31-0 in that stretch
THEN WE'RE THE SUN ☀️☀️ we're bringing the sun Keys
you can't bring the sun
Packed 12 towels and a hair dryer. Don't ask about the hair dryer.
Play the ball you got, youngin. Not the weather you want.
WE BEAT THE RAIN 🌧️➡️☀️ IT STOPPED RAINING. I DID THAT
rain stopped in the 7th. we were up 5. Dre did not do that
The hair dryer was for the ball. Every inning. Lou said it's legal.
Captain Drizzle shook my hand. it was wet. everything here is wet
Two more on the ladder, youngins. Then the bracket. Then we see.
San Diego. let's ride
Slipped, {crew}? Happens. Come back anytime. It'll still be raining.
Twelve towels wasn't enough. I'm buying twenty.
run it back
hey. I've been damp since birth. Never minded till today.
Y'all played like the sun was out. I want to play like that.
you any good when it's dry?
Never tried. Bet I'm unstoppable.
Got room on {crew} for a rain kid?
Surf's up, {crew}. Rode one at sunrise. Riding y'all this afternoon.
RIPTIDE pulls your outfield in. Then the kick lands where they used to be.
Court's by the beach. Sand in your cleats is home field. Totally legal.
we'll shake 'em out
Tsunami 18-3. two Ls to Portland. the third was a sunburn forfeit
a SUNBURN FORFEIT 😭 Tasha we need more sunscreen
Brought the big bottle. Pops gets two coats. Ears too, Pops.
I've had these ears since before you were born, youngin. They're fine.
WE RODE THE TSUNAMI 🌊🏄 SURFED IT ALL THE WAY HOME
Riptide Rafa pulled our outfield in. so we kicked it over him. simple
Fish Taco Tomas made us fish tacos after. The man lives his name.
One more on the ladder, youngins. Portland. Then the bracket. Then...
SAY IT POPS
Not yet, youngin. The bus taught me that.
Portland. timber
Wiped out, {crew}! It's cool. Everybody wipes out. Paddle back.
lost to a crew that surfed at 6am first. I respect it. I hate it
run it back
bro. I surf. I kick. I don't do much else. Benny says that's enough.
Y'all play like it matters. Like Nationals is real. I want that.
it's real
Then let me ride the wave with you. Room on {crew}?
{crew}. We split logs. We kick balls. Same swing.
When I yell TIMBER, somebody falls. Usually the outfield.
We beat everybody out here twice. We'll beat y'all twice.
you get one shot
Lumberjacks 24-0. no forfeits. no buses. nothing. it's a wall in flannel
WALLS FALL 🪓🔥 we been knocking walls down all summer
Rain jacket AND sunscreen. Portland does both in one hour.
Big crews fall loud, youngin. Stay standing.
...last rung of the last ladder. '98 never saw one. Go see it for me.
WE CHOPPED THE LUMBERJACKS 🪓😭 LADDER!!! DONE!!!
24-0 is 24-1 now. I wrote it in pen
Big Timber gave Pops his flannel. Pops won't take it off.
It's a good flannel, youngin.
Five ladders. Five. I'm sitting down a minute.
POPS IS CRYING
Pine pollen. Portland's got the worst kind.
bracket. then Baltimore
TIMBER. Told you somebody falls. Get up, {crew}. Try again.
we got chopped. there's sawdust in my shoe. I don't know how
run it back
Big Timber says flannel's earned. Had mine six years.
Never saw a crew take the TIMBER swing and stand back up like that.
what you swing?
An axe on weekdays. A leg on Saturdays. Both hard.
Room on {crew} for a lumberjack?
{crew}. Lou. Last bracket. Win it and I call Baltimore myself.
Semi Saturday vs San Diego. Final Sunday. Clean shoes. Still checking.
Five regions from nowhere. One weekend away. Try not to think about it.
too late
Bracket's set. Win Sunday and I send one text. One word.
I KNOW THE WORD AND I'M ALREADY CRYING 😭😭😭
every crew at Nationals is a crew we already beat. every single one
'98 we made the bracket and the bus died. Youngins, check the plane.
Pops the semi is 20 minutes away. by car
Check it anyway.
see y'all at 6
Rematch, {crew}. Surfed every sunrise since. Legs are different now.
Biggest tide of the year Saturday. Don't get pulled out.
we can swim
Tsunami 5-0 since we beat them. Benny shaved his head. that's commitment
I'M SHAVING MY HEAD TOO 😤
You're not. Team photos are Sunday.
One wave at a time, youngin. Nobody fights the ocean and wins.
WEST FINAL BABY 🌊🏆 WE SURFED IT TWICE
Benny shaved his head for nothing. I feel bad. a little
Big Timber texted me one word: "good." That's it. Just good.
One game, youngins. One game between this block and Nationals.
one game
Riptide pulled you out, {crew}. Paddle back if you can.
Lou says re-enter. I'm already in the car.
then we're still in it
Said we beat everybody twice. Here's twice.
Win, you go to Baltimore. Lose, you go home. Either way you're going somewhere.
Bring your whole block, {crew}. Let 'em see the swing up close.
they're watching. trust
Youngins. Phones down after this. I'm only saying it once.
All these years I told y'all about a bus. Tomorrow ain't about a bus.
Tomorrow's about you.
50-50. first time all summer. I'm not rounding
BEEN CRYING SINCE THE SEMI 😭 IT'S A LIFESTYLE NOW
Cooler's packed. Flannel's washed, Pops. You can wear it.
west final. let's eat
WE WON THE WEST!!!! FIVE REGIONS!!!!! 🌊🌵🌴👑
five. regions. I don't have a number for this. I looked
Big Timber handed me the trophy. Then handed Pops another flannel.
...Youngins.
Nobody from this block ever made Nationals.
Till right now.
POPS IS—
It's pollen. Let me have it.
TIMBER. Twice. Told you. Get up, {crew}. I'll be right here.
We been this close before, youngin. Difference is the bus still runs.
again
NATIONALS. 🏆
NATIONALS!!!!!!! 😭😭😭👑👑👑
the field: Philly, Cleveland, Miami, Albuquerque, Portland. we beat all five
they've all gotten better since. I checked that too
Last game's in Baltimore, youngins. THE CROWN. Where Tasha touched the fence.
Through a LOCKED gate. And that was pollen.
This time the gate's open.
then we walk in
{crew}. Lou. Called Baltimore like I said. They know your name.
Five regional champs. One court. Nobody from your block ever got this far.
Clean shoes. I check.
we know
